meta.title: DEXPI XML I01V01-VER.EX01.xml
meta.converted_by: scripts/dexpi_reader.py (no model; every item cites its XML element ID)
meta.not_a_drawing_of_record: Converted from an exported file. Nothing here is verified by anyone; units of instruments and valves are inferred through the piping (unit_basis).

streams.name: Line PNS1: T01 to BL
streams.to_end: closed end at PNS1_S1_C1: the line stops here; BL stands in because a stream needs two ends

instruments.unit_basis: first unit upstream through the piping from PNS1_S1_C1 (1 step(s), via T01_N3)

line_layers.method: scripts/dexpi_reader.py from the XML's piping topology

definitions.piped_to: a process pipe segment joins the two directly: consecutive along a drawn run, through bends and past instrument taps, with no pipe tee or other item between; or two items drawn against each other with nothing between (touching: no line is drawn, so the segment is on no line network unless both ends already share one)
definitions.junction: a point where three or more drawn line arms meet. junction_kind says which: pipe_tee (three or more pipe arms: a tee or branch), instrument_tap (an instrument line meets a pipe that carries on through it: the tap sits on the pipe segment named by on_segment and does not split it), marked_crossing (a 4-arm crossing the drawing marks connected with a dot), instrument_line_junction (instrument lines meeting away from a pipe)
definitions.instrument_connection: a drawn line that joins an instrument (its bubble) to a pipe at a tap, to an item, or to another instrument line: a leader, impulse or signal line, not a process pipe
definitions.actuated_by: a valve and the actuator drawn stacked on it (a small symbol beside the valve box, joined only by a short stem): the stem is part of the valve, not a pipe
definitions.nozzle_of: a nozzle mark (N1, N2...) and the vessel it sits on: the short stub between them is part of the vessel, not a pipe
definitions.line_network: drawn lines that touch one another outside the item boxes, through bends, junctions or crossings, as the tracer joins them (its network). Lines that meet only at an item's edge can be joined: such a network names that item in joined_only_at
definitions.network_pair: the tracer's pairwise link: both items are on the same line network (not pipe adjacency)

line_layers.note: pipe items only: units (through their nozzles), valves and the battery limit (off-page connectors and open ends). Instruments are joined to the piping by measuring lines, which are not pipes; their place is in sits_on and measures.
